name: Scarlet Monastery Graveyard
summary: Undead haunt Scarlet Monastery Graveyard in northeastern Tirisfal Glades. Lordaeron's clergy and nobility once rested here in peace, but neglect and Bloodmage Thalnos's corrupted magic now trouble the burial wing.

sections.title: A Defiled Sanctuary
sections.body: Before the Third War, Lordaeron's priests rested in peace in this cloistered cemetery. When the Scarlet Crusade fortified the monastery against the undead, its fanatical watch left the crypts uncleansed. Now the Graveyard lies neglected and haunted. Lingering spirits, restless corpses, and shambling horrors wander the Chamber of Atonement and the mist-covered Forlorn Cloister. Beneath the Crusade's uncaring gaze, the dead suffer endless torment instead of hallowed rest.

sections.title: Corruption from Within
sections.body: At the rear of the grounds, Honor's Tomb holds Bloodmage Thalnos, who mocks the Crusade's dogma. No record tells who he was in life. The plague of undeath claimed him, and he rose as a skeletal horror wielding shadow bolts and fire. The crusaders above preach the total extermination of the undead plague. Yet a rotting, fallen sorcerer remains in their consecrated soil.

faq.q: Why are there undead inside a Scarlet Crusade stronghold?
faq.answer: The Crusade's leadership is consumed by fanaticism. It sends crusaders outward to slaughter living outsiders and wage war in Tirisfal. Meanwhile, the monastery's crypts and burial plots lie utterly neglected, allowing dormant plague remnants and restless spirits of dead clergy to rise unchecked.
No record tells who Thalnos was in life. The plague of undeath claimed him, and he rose as a skeletal spellcaster who rules the desecrated crypts of Honor's Tomb.

faq.q: Where is the Graveyard wing located inside the monastery?
faq.answer: Enter the Grand Vestibule of the Scarlet Monastery and take the leftmost portal to reach the Graveyard. It needs no key, unlike the Armory and Cathedral wings.
The Forlorn Cloister is an open-air garden and cemetery between the entrance crypts and Honor's Tomb. Tombstones, roaming ghouls, and damp earth rich in Grave Moss fill the grounds.

angles.text: The damp, defiled soil of the Forlorn Cloister is one of northern Lordaeron's most reliable places to gather Grave Moss.
As a Forsaken, you may see the Graveyard as grim proof of the Crusade's hypocrisy. Its zealots condemn the Forsaken while an undead bloodmage rots in their basement.
